name: Command palette
summary: A searchable list of pages and actions in a dialog, opened with Ctrl+K or Cmd+K.
description:
Use a command palette in apps with many pages and actions, so people who know what they want can get there by typing. It complements the navigation; it does not replace it.

It is a .v-dialog.v-command: a search input with role="combobox" over a role="listbox" of options, grouped. data-v-command adds the shortcut, filtering (by text and data-keywords, ignoring case and accents), the arrow keys and Enter. Options are real links and buttons: running one clicks it, so links navigate and buttons run your own handlers, then the dialog closes.

classes.name: v-command
classes.description: On a .v-dialog: the palette layout, placed high in the viewport.

classes.name: v-command-search
classes.description: The row with the search icon, the input and an Esc hint.

classes.name: v-command-input
classes.description: The input, with role="combobox", aria-controls pointing at the list and aria-autocomplete="list".

classes.name: v-command-list
classes.description: The role="listbox" of options. Group them in role="group" with aria-labelledby on a .v-command-label.

classes.name: v-command-item
classes.description: One option: an <a> or <button> with role="option". An icon and a <kbd> hint can sit inside.

classes.name: v-command-empty
classes.description: A role="status" element that says when nothing matches. Hidden while empty. Set data-template to change the words; {q} is the query.

classes.name: v-command-footer
classes.description: An optional row of key hints, aria-hidden because the keys are announced by the combobox pattern itself.

states.description: On the highlighted option, set by the JS together with aria-activedescendant on the input.
On an option: extra words it should match, such as "invoices plan" on Billing.
Set by the JS on options and groups that do not match.

hooks.name: data-v-command
hooks.description: Ctrl or Cmd plus the letter opens and closes it. Resets and focuses the input on every open, filters as you type, and runs the highlighted option on Enter.

hooks.name: data-v-dialog-open
hooks.description: Opens the palette from a visible control. Always offer one: a shortcut alone is not discoverable.

hooks.name: data-v-dismissable
hooks.description: A click on the backdrop closes it.

events.name: v:command
events.description: Fires before an option runs. Call preventDefault() to keep the dialog open and skip the default click.

keyboard.action: Opens or closes the palette from anywhere on the page.
Moves the highlight through the visible options, across groups, and wraps.
Closes the palette and returns focus to where it was.

a11y: Focus stays in the input while the highlight moves: aria-activedescendant tells screen readers which option is active.
Ctrl+K uses a modifier, so it does not clash with typing (WCAG 2.1.4). Show it on the button that opens the palette.
The empty message is a live region that stays in the page, so "No results" is announced.
Options are links and buttons underneath: a mouse click, Enter and assistive tech all run the same thing.
